# Champion

`sales.obj.core.champion` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **core**

> Someone inside the buying organisation who wants us to win and will spend their own credibility to make it happen. Distinct from a friendly contact: a friendly contact answers our emails, a champion argues for us in a room we are not in. The test is not warmth, it is whether they take internal risk on our behalf. A champion without access to the Decision Maker is pleasant and worthless.


Also called: `Internal Advocate`, `Coach`, `Mobilizer`

## Constraints

- **`ch.cannot_approve`** A champion cannot approve a purchase unless access_to_decision_maker= is_decision_maker.
- **`ch.do_not_bypass`** Approaching the decision maker around the champion, without tellingthem, reliably destroys the advocacy. Bypass is a last resort, not an optimisation.
- **`ch.new_tenure_limits_weight`** Under six months of tenure, advocacy carries reducedinternal weight regardless of strength. _(soft)_


## Business rules

- **`ch.no_access_no_forecast`** A deal whose only advocate has access_to_decision_maker = none must not be forecast above best-case.
- **`ch.sole_advocate_is_concentration_risk`** A live deal with exactly one advocate carries a concentration risk that must be surfaced, not noted.
- **`ch.departure_voids_prior_qualification`** On champion_change, every qualification judgement that rested on this person's account of the internal politics reverts to unverified. It does not merely lower confidence.

- **`ch.champion_is_not_decision_maker`** A champion may not be recorded as the approving authority unless access_to_decision_maker = is_decision_maker.

## Actions

- **Ask for an introduction to the approver** (human) — Converts advocacy into access. The highest-yield and most-skipped move in the qualification stage.
- **Send an internal-selling pack** (human) — One page they canforward without editing. Most deals are decided in a room we are not in.
- **Build a second advocate** (human) — Removes concentration risk.
- **Re-engage a quiet champion** (human) —

## Examples

- **The Mobilizer** — Mid-level, high credibility, arranges everything. Best possible champion.
- **The friendly contact** — Warm, responsive, takes zero internal risk. Not a champion— the most common misclassification.
- **The champion who is also the buyer** — access_to_decision_maker = is_decision_maker.SMB norm; cycle collapses.
- **The departed champion** — champion_change fires and the deal quietly reverts to a coldoutbound.
